desc.zh: 从可达距离推导最大堆贪心，用可回退的补给记录证明最少停靠次数。
desc.en: Derive the maximum-fuel greedy choice from reachable distance, then inspect a reversible refueling ledger.

complexity: O(n log(n+1)) time; O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Reach and eligibility
concepts.description: Only stations at or before reach may enter the candidate pool.

concepts.name: Greedy exchange
concepts.description: The largest reachable unchosen supply is safe to select.

concepts.name: Python heap implementation
concepts.description: Negative fuel values implement a max-heap with heapq.
